tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List Kubernetes events, newest first, for a namespace or for one object, such as back-offs, failed scheduling, OOM kills, image pull errors and scaling.

kind.description: Only events about objects of this kind, for example Pod or Deployment.

limit.description: The most events to return. Default 50, at most 500.

name.description: Only events about the object with this name.

namespace.description: The namespace. Empty means every namespace Sidekick may read.

since.description: Only what happened after this: an RFC 3339 time, or a duration back from now such as 30m or 2h.

tools.name: get_workload
tools.description: Get the status of a Deployment, StatefulSet or DaemonSet: replicas, conditions, container images, rollout strategy and any horizontal pod autoscaler that scales it.

tools.name: list_pod_problems
tools.description: List pods that have problems: restarts, OOM kills, CrashLoopBackOff and other waiting reasons, pods that cannot be scheduled, failed or evicted pods, and containers that are not ready.

labelSelector.description: A label selector, for example app=checkout or tier in (web,api).

limit.description: The most pods to return. Default 50, at most 200.

namespace.description: The namespace. Empty means every namespace Sidekick may read.

tools.name: get_rollout_history
tools.description: Get the rollout history of a Deployment: its ReplicaSet revisions, newest first, with creation times, images and what changed from the revision before, to see recent changes.

limit.description: The most revisions to return. Default 10, at most 50.

tools.name: get_pod_logs
tools.description: Get the last lines of the logs of one container of a pod, with timestamps.

container.description: The container. Required when the pod has more than one.

previous.description: Return the logs of the container's previous run, for example before a crash.

since.description: Only what happened after this: an RFC 3339 time, or a duration back from now such as 30m or 2h.

tailLines.description: How many lines to return, from the end. Default 200, at most 2000.

tools.name: list_nodes
tools.description: List nodes with their conditions (ready, memory, disk and PID pressure), cordons, taints, roles, kubelet versions and allocatable resources.

limit.description: The most nodes to return. Default 100, at most 500.

name.description: Only the node with this name.

problemsOnly.description: Only nodes that are not ready, are under pressure or are cordoned.
